name: Phenylbenzimidazole sulfonic acid
description: Phenylbenzimidazole sulfonic acid ( CAS 27503-81-7 ), commonly abbreviated as PBSA, is a water-soluble UV filter used primarily in sun care and personal care formulations. Unlike oil-soluble UV absorbers, its water solubility makes it suitable for aqueous and hydrophilic systems. This chemical is ideal for applications where broad-spectrum UVB protection is required. PBSA is a regulated UVB-filtering active in sunscreens, functioning across lotions, sprays, and gel formulations where water-phase UV protection is needed. In pharmaceutical topical preparations, it provides photostabilization to light-sensitive active ingredients, extending product shelf life and efficacy. Personal care manufacturers incorporate it into daily moisturizers and after-sun products. These formulations deliver UVB protection without compromising texture or transparency. It also appears in combination UV filter systems alongside UVA absorbers, where its water solubility complements oil-phase actives to achieve full-spectrum coverage. PBSA is supplied as a white to off-white crystalline powder. It is available in cosmetic-grade and pharmaceutical-grade specifications, with purity levels typically at 98% or higher to meet regulatory requirements in sun care markets. Suppliers commonly offer it in compliance with EU Cosmetics Regulation and equivalent international standards governing UV filter actives.
